basis: Class I KNOX TF maintaining indeterminacy; Xenium SAM+hypocotyl and KNOX immunolocalization, DE cl5 pct 0.11 vs 0.01 (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun); in situ SAM of coleoptilar-stage embryos (Zhang et al. 2002 Planta); Meristem 2 cluster 0.41 vs 0.14 and SAM+P6 KN1 cluster 0.60 vs 0.03 (Satterlee et al. 2020 PNAS). Also marks embryonic stem/hypocotyl.

KNOX TF liguleless3 (HB74); Xenium SAM+hypocotyl, DE cl5 0.40 vs 0.03 (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun); Meristem 2 cluster 0.31 vs 0.08 and SAM+P6 KN1 cluster 0.68 vs 0.03 (Satterlee et al. 2020 PNAS). Also stem.
KNOX TF rough sheath1; Xenium SAM+hypocotyl (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun); SAM+P6 KN1 cluster 0.52 vs 0.02 (Satterlee et al. 2020 PNAS). Also stem.
WUSCHEL ortholog of the organizing center; Xenium only a few SAM cells (and coleoptile tip) and not a scRNA DE gene (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun); expect very sparse detection.

Cytokinin-activating LOG at the SAM tip (log7 mutant affects SAM); Xenium + conventional ISH SAM tip (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun); Tip cluster 0.40 vs 0.007, in situ per Knauer 2019 Genome Res (Satterlee et al. 2020 PNAS). CONFLICT: in Wu scRNA its strongest cluster is adaxial scutellum epidermis (cl6 0.81 vs 0.23); see the Scutellum_Adaxial_Epidermis row.

NAC boundary gene; Xenium SAM and SAM/lateral-organ boundary, not a scRNA DE gene; Wu cluster 16 "boundary" did not express it (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun). In Satterlee et al. 2020 PNAS it is in the Tip cluster (0.43 vs 0.07) and their Dataset S2 cites in situ (Johnston 2014 Plant Cell; not re-read).

YABBY (CRC co-ortholog) required for leaf patterning; Xenium leaf only, absent from coleoptile/scutellum, DE cl20 0.39 vs 0.002 (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun); in situ incipient and emergent leaf primordia, not SAM or stem (Strable et al. 2017 Plant Cell); SAM+P6 primordium cluster 0.20 vs 0.04 (Satterlee et al. 2020 PNAS).

LOB/AS2 ortholog for adaxial leaf identity (ig1 leaf polarity defects, Evans 2007 Plant Cell); Xenium adaxial leaf and coleoptile, DE cl20 0.23 vs 0.001 (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun). Adaxial domain only.
MADS-box TF (NCBI symbol MADS14, aliases zmm8/M8); Xenium leaf/coleoptile boundary, DE cl20 0.36 vs 0.002 (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun).
YABBY TF; Xenium lateral organs at all three stages (leaf tip, early scutellum tip); not a scRNA DE gene (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun). Not leaf-specific.

WOX3/PRESSED FLOWER homolog; ns1 ns2 lose the lateral leaf domain; in situ in lateral meristem foci and primordium margins (Nardmann et al. 2004 Development); Xenium lateral-organ gene, DE cl9 0.06 vs 0.001 (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun). UniProt Q70UV1 also names it WOX3A.

WOX3-clade homeobox (paper and NCBI: wox3A/HB82); Xenium lateral organs at L1 and coleoptilar stage (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun). Different locus from NS1 although UniProt gives NS1 the name WOX3A; compare by ID.
BTB/ankyrin BOP-like (NCBI NH5.1) gene for proximal/sheath identity (function by homology); Xenium coleoptile, absent from scutellum, DE cl13 0.20 vs 0.004 (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun).
tassels replace upper ears1, BOP-like BTB/ankyrin gene; Xenium coleoptile (Supp Fig 4); not a scRNA DE gene (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun).
LOG-family cytokinin activator; Xenium coleoptile, DE cl13 0.27 vs 0.02 (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun).
Stearoyl-ACP desaturase; Xenium coleoptile, DE cl9 0.20 vs 0.01 (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun).
FPF1-like; Xenium coleoptile and leaf tip, DE cl9 0.23 vs 0.04 (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun); epidermis cluster in shoot apex with in situ (Satterlee et al. 2020 PNAS). Not coleoptile-specific.

HD-ZIP IV TF of the L1 (ocl4 trichome/anther defects, Vernoud 2009 Plant J); in situ protoderm, adaxial face of the embryo proper (Ingram et al. 2000 Plant J); Xenium epidermis (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun; weak in their scRNA, cl2 0.66 vs 0.40); Epidermis 1 cluster 0.69 vs 0.12 and SAM+P6 epidermis 0.86 vs 0.16 (Satterlee et al. 2020 PNAS).

ABCG cuticle-lipid exporter (Arabidopsis ABCG11/DSO class); Xenium lateral-organ epidermis, DE cl9 0.15 vs 0.01 (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun); SAM+P6 epidermis cluster 0.66 vs 0.11 (Satterlee et al. 2020 PNAS).

Bet v I/MLP protein (NCBI LOC542195, alias prp2); Xenium coleoptile epidermis, DE cl9 0.46 vs 0.09 (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun); Epidermis 1 cluster 0.50 vs 0.11 and SAM+P6 epidermis 0.67 vs 0.19 (Satterlee et al. 2020 PNAS). ID corrected from review (Zm00001eb080390).

3-ketoacyl-CoA synthase (VLCFA/cuticle); Xenium coleoptile, leaf and adaxial scutellum base, DE cl9 0.19 vs 0.06 (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun); SAM+P6 epidermis 0.52 vs 0.11 (Satterlee et al. 2020 PNAS). Xenium pattern is organ-level, so not raised.

LOG cytokinin activator; Xenium adaxial scutellum (plus SAM tip), top DE gene of cl6 0.81 vs 0.23 (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun). Use with the Shoot_Apical_Meristem row; SAM vs scutellum is resolved by other markers.
Uncharacterized; Xenium and Visium enriched in adaxial scutellum epidermis, DE cl6 0.67 vs 0.12 (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun).

MATE transporter; bige1 enlarges the scutellum (Suzuki et al. 2015 Plant Cell); Xenium adaxial scutellum, SAM tip and SAM/organ boundary, DE cl6 0.22 vs 0.03 (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun). Not specific.

NF-YB LEAFY COTYLEDON1; Xenium adaxial scutellum, not coleoptile, DE cl6 0.38 vs 0.25 (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun). CONFLICT: in situ shows the whole embryo proper early, fading in the scutellum (Zhang et al. 2002 Planta).
Glycine-rich cell-wall protein (uncharacterized); Xenium and Visium abaxial scutellum epidermis, DE cl1 0.25 vs 0.06 (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun).
Uncharacterized; Xenium and Visium abaxial scutellum epidermis, DE cl2 (heat-shock state) 0.22 vs 0.06 (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun). v3->v5 crosswalk also lists Zm00001eb083650; v5 model not resolved.

Class III peroxidase; Xenium and Visium abaxial scutellum epidermis (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun). CAUTION: its scRNA DE cluster is the G2/M cluster 12 (0.31 vs 0.02), so it may mark dividing epithelium cells.
CAP/SCP-domain protein (paper symbol OEC23); Xenium abaxial scutellum epidermis; not a scRNA DE gene (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun).
FLZ-domain protein; Xenium apical scutellum, DE cl4 0.18 vs 0.05 (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun).
Globulin-1 embryo storage protein; DE cl4 0.84 vs 0.50 (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun); broad in embryo, rises with maturation.
ACT-domain bHLH-like; Xenium apical scutellum but also coleoptile and leaf base, DE cl4 0.31 vs 0.07 (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun).
GR1a/cortical cell-delineating protein; Xenium lower scutellum plus leaf/SAM and scutellum/coleoptile boundaries, DE cl0 0.26 vs 0.11 (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun).
WOX homeobox (paper WOX11; NCBI WOX6-like); Xenium basal scutellum (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun). CONFLICT: scRNA DE in the SAM+stem cluster 5 (0.18 vs 0.05).

GRAS SHORT-ROOT ortholog (GRAS19), stele/provascular TF; Xenium vasculature, DE cl14 0.13 vs 0.002 (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun); Vasculature cluster 0.14 vs 0.01 and SAM+P6 vascular cluster 0.77 vs 0.16 (Satterlee et al. 2020 PNAS).

PIN1 auxin efflux carrier for provascular canalization; Xenium vasculature, DE cl14 0.11 vs 0.005 (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun); ZmPIN1 in developing embryos (Forestan et al. 2010 Plant Physiol, not cell-type resolved). ID corrected from review JSON (Zm00001eb372190).
bHLH (NCBI AIG1-like); Xenium vasculature, DE cl14 0.14 vs 0.002 (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun).
ZF-HD TF; Xenium vasculature; not a scRNA DE gene (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun).

SCARECROW; in situ endodermis and QC of maize root meristems including the embryo (Lim et al. 2000 Plant Cell); Xenium pre-root and adaxial leaf (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun). Weak in Wu scRNA (rejected cl15, 0.38 vs 0.14); also leaf inner layers.
SBP TF; Xenium hypocotyl and pre-root, DE cl18 (stress state) 0.19 vs 0.01 (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun).
Extensin-like (uncharacterized); Xenium pre-root, DE cl2 0.22 vs 0.08 (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun).
WOX9/STIP-clade homeobox; Xenium suspensor (Supp Fig 2s) (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun). CONFLICT: scRNA DE in SAM+stem cluster 5 (0.13 vs 0.02), not in suspensor cluster 21.
WOX9/STIP-clade homeobox; Xenium suspensor; not a scRNA DE gene (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun).
WOX9-clade homeobox; Xenium suspensor although the authors expected SAM (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun). NCBI aliases list both wox9A and wox9b: symbol conflict, compare by ID.

27-kDa gamma-zein storage prolamin of starchy endosperm; DE cl19 log2FC 5.5 (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun). Contaminant marker for embryo data; high ambient background (pct2 0.19). ID corrected from review JSON (Zm00001eb313810); UniProt P04706.
SWEET sugar transporter; Xenium endosperm (expected embryo/endosperm boundary), DE cl19 0.18 vs 0.02 (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun).
MYB TF; Xenium endosperm, top DE of the "suspensor" cluster 21 (0.44 vs 0.001) (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun), so cluster 21 is probably endosperm (ESR/EAS) residue.

Cytokinesis syntaxin (G2/M); Wu cl12 0.91 vs 0.35 (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun); SAM+P6 dividing cluster 0.91 vs 0.23 (Satterlee et al. 2020 PNAS). ID corrected from review (Zm00001eb215340 is a 116-aa uncharacterized model).
Mitotic B-type cyclin (cyclin IaZm); Wu cl12 0.73 vs 0.27 (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun); SAM+P6 dividing cluster 0.88 vs 0.19 (Satterlee et al. 2020 PNAS).

Centromeric histone H3 (UniProt Q8LK76); Wu cl12 0.92 vs 0.36 (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun); SAM+P6 dividing cluster 0.90 vs 0.33 (Satterlee et al. 2020 PNAS). ID corrected (crosswalk first model Zm00001eb291200 is an ARF GTPase).
